# Vibe Hub

> Vibe Hub (https://vibehome.dog) is an onchain app for the $VIBE ecosystem on Base (chain ID 8453): holder rewards, Vibe Club NFT royalties, staking, swaps, the Vibe Club NFT, daily check-ins, soulbound achievements and a Vibe Agent Wallet that AI agents operate for the user. Every action is a Base transaction; the rules live in verified smart contracts.

Agents: read-only data comes from public GET endpoints that return JSON and ready-to-send transactions. Acting for a user goes through their Vibe Agent Wallet with an agent key they create at https://vibehome.dog/agents, within permissions and daily limits they set. Never ask a user for a private key or seed phrase.

## Agent docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://vibehome.dog/AGENTS.md): Entry point for agents: what Vibe Hub is, endpoints, contracts and rules.
- [API reference](https://vibehome.dog/skills/API.md): Every public endpoint and its response fields.
- [Vibe Hub agent skill](https://vibehome.dog/skills/vibe-hub/SKILL.md): Skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and OpenClaw, acting from the user's Vibe Agent Wallet.
- [Bankr skill](https://vibehome.dog/skills/bankr/SKILL.md): Skill for Bankr, acting from the user's Bankr wallet with public ready transactions.

## User docs

- [Docs](https://vibehome.dog/docs): Full user guide.
- [How rewards work](https://vibehome.dog/docs/how-rewards-work): Snapshots, Merkle rounds, claim windows, burn of unclaimed rewards.
- [Agent API guide](https://vibehome.dog/docs/agent-api): Setting up an agent and what it can do.
- [$VIBE token](https://vibehome.dog/docs/vibe-token): Token, supply and contracts.
- [Official addresses](https://vibehome.dog/contracts): Every verified contract address.

## Try it

- [Read-only demo](https://vibehome.dog/hub#demo): The whole app as a real holder with live onchain data, no wallet needed; transactions are previewed, never sent.
